summary: Milestone execution completed 13 experiments in the locked 5.7-minute wall time, including 4 compute-bound experiments. The 2-minute three-family translate-run-inspect-repair A/B was the longest compute-bound task, followed by the 1-minute adapter-disabled live E3 structured-memory A/B; the available GPU state showed 0% utilization on both devices, while no supplied evidence establishes a concurrent multi-model DualGPURunner miss.

bottlenecks_identified: Compute was scheduled, but the GPU monitor showed 0% utilization on both devices; with compute-bound work present, this is an execution-path defect rather than expected synthesis-only behavior.

The longest compute-bound entries took 2 minutes and 1 minute, but disk-mtime reconstruction provides no phase timing that can explain whether gating, model loading, inference, inspection, or repair caused the elapsed time.

Runner-selection efficiency cannot be audited because the supplied data does not record task-linked model count, overlap, or runner choice; therefore no concurrent multi-model DualGPURunner miss is established.
improvements_suggested: Add a task-scoped GPU-engagement guard that samples utilization during every compute-bound phase and emits a diagnostic when utilization remains at 0% while GPU work is pending.

Persist model count, overlap interval, and selected runner with each compute-bound task; choose DualGPURunner only when multiple models are actually loaded in parallel, while leaving single-model work on one GPU.
Emit monotonic start, end, and phase timings from the conductor so future retrospectives can replace disk-mtime reconstruction with direct attribution.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument compute-bound tasks with a task-linked GPU-engagement guard.
Record model concurrency and runner selection, conditionally selecting DualGPURunner for parallel multi-model work.
Capture direct monotonic phase timings instead of relying on disk modification times.
meta_reflection: The bounded data ranks the compute tail but does not causally explain its 2-minute and 1-minute durations or correlate the idle snapshot with a particular phase. The savings estimate therefore remains 0% until the GPU-engagement guard and direct phase timings produce a measured before-and-after comparison.
